[h1]One Mans Treasures[/h1]

[i]The authorities have not rested since news broke of “Dark-Minds” resurfacing; A notorious smuggling ring known for trafficking religious and magical items. Investigators had previously believed its members to have been wiped out until reports began surfacing that priceless artifacts have recently gone missing.

Legends say one of the missing items, the “Creator Stone” has the power to create beasts from the darkness... The ordinary looking stone in the wrong hands is no treasure, it is a threat to all Shardian kind. We must stop “Dark-Mind” before they discover the “Creator Stones” true power...[/i]
